## This week

The loop, owned: last week it ran invisibly inside the client; this week it is built by hand — Call, Judge, Execute, Reinject, with an explicit bound. The measured failure of an Act-only protocol, the ReAct convention (a written Thought before every action, grounding), why today's tool-calling models carry that convention in their weights, and trace reading as the basic debugging procedure.

## Lab

`W4_lab_loop.ipynb` — the agent loop in about twenty-five lines, with the Judge step as your fill-in; Act-only vs. ReAct compared on a five-question mini evalset that re-scores every later week; trace reading on a run that fabricates; the step bound as an honest exit. Built for this course, following the from-scratch pattern of Hugging Face's Agents Course unit 1.

Homework: `W4_hw_loop_guard.ipynb` — add the repetition guard, show it converting a spinning run into a finished answer, and grow the evalset with two multi-hop questions of your own. Due before Week 5.

Run it in Colab: click **Open in Colab** (links above), paste your API key into the setup cell ([API Setup](api-setup.qmd)), and run top to bottom.
